details.description: Electrorush ORS Pack can help manage body fluids and electrolytes lost due to dehydration. This ready-to-drink ORS can help provide rehydration and energy boost and replenish the body with essential electrolytes. It can help maintain electrolyte balance in the body to manage heat and dehydration. It may also reduce stress, fatigue and pain.
details.usageInstructions:
Dose: The dose should be appropriately adjusted to patient's
requirement for maintenance and replacement of fluids.
Do not buy/consume if the pack is puffed
Use the contents within 24 hours after opening.
Indications: To be used in conditions of diarrhoea, vomiting
and when there is loss of water and electrolytes. ORS can be a good replacement
of lost fluids and electrolytes.
Caution: Depressed renal function. Severe continuing diarrhoea or other critical fluid losses may need supplementation with other parenteral fluids along with ORS.
Not For Injection
